summary: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi Scheme (PM-KISAN): — Flagship scheme comprehensively covered in the Government Schemes Consolidated Masterfile.

blocks.title: 🏛️ Canonical Reference & Masterfile Integration
blocks.text: This flagship scheme is comprehensively detailed in the Government Schemes Masterfile (Section: "migrated-schemes-masterfile"). Key highlights and parameters are summarized below.

items: Objective: To provide financial support to farmers for meeting short-term needs and boosting
Benefits: ₹6,000 annually in 3 installments of ₹2,000 each, directly transferred to bank accounts.
Eligibility: All landholder farmer families. 11 crore farmers eligible across India.
Ineligible: Public representatives, ministers, pensioners earning over ₹10,000/month, income
Exclusions: Those holding constitutional posts and income tax payers.
This initiative aims to improve farmers' economic condition by providing direct financial assistance
